description: Native ES modules loaded via <script type="module">, no bundler. Obfuscated post-build by the `afterpack` CLI (docs/framework-integration.md -- CLI universal-fallback row). Proves the CLI preserves ESM import/export names + relative specifiers so the sibling-module graph still links at runtime.

build.note: no bundler: build.mjs stages src/ -> dist/ then runs `afterpack ./dist` -- a plain `npm run build` already emits obfuscated output

interactions.description: Clicking the counter runs the obfuscated cross-module import graph (state.js -> math.js) and re-renders.
